author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API change. The model manager's file-discovery logic is internal; users interact via the model list API. Before the fix, users with shard files at the root saw each shard as a separate model (incorrect behavior per the custom model guide). After the fix they see one model (correct behavior per the guide). This corrects a bug rather than introducing a breaking change.
evidence.documentation: No documentation updates needed. The custom model guide (#3633) already specifies the shard rule. This fix makes the implementation match the documented behavior, so existing docs are correct and complete.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Not required. The existing Python integration test directly exercises the model discovery path for root-level shard files, which is the only behavior this commit changes. Users place GGUF files in extra_models_dir and see them listed through the model API — the test covers this end-to-end.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR contains one commit (dd8a7d54) from the PR branch and one squash commit (35e62510) for the merge. No commits were added after the approval on 2026-10-01T11:44:37Z.
evidence.review: PR #3656 was approved by @fl0rianr with 'LGTM' on 2026-10-01T11:44:37Z. The change is a single small commit (36 insertions, 15 deletions across two files) that extracts the shard-grouping logic into a shared helper and applies it to root-level files. The review was minimal — one approval, no inline comments — and @fl0rianr's subject-area expertise from docs/dev/contribute.md covers CI and LMX rather than the C++ model_manager code specifically. For a 30-line refactor, this is acceptable, but a reviewer with C++ server-side expertise would have been a better fit.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change is a pure file-discovery logic refactor within model_manager.cpp — no new execution paths, no credential handling, no network calls, no supply-chain changes.
evidence.tests: New test test_021yf_extra_root_shards_are_one_model in test/server_endpoints.py validates that two shard files (Big-Q4_K_M-00001-of-00002.gguf and Big-Q4_K_M-00002-of-00002.gguf) at the root are listed as one model 'Big-Q4_K_M', while a non-shard file (Small-Q8_0.gguf) remains a separate model. The author confirmed the new test fails without the C++ change. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

subject: fix(models): group shard files at the extra_models_dir root (#3656)
summary: Makes model discovery group shard files placed directly in the extra_models_dir root into a single model (matching the grouping behavior already used for files inside subdirectories), instead of listing each shard file as a separate model.
verdict_reason: Spec-driven bug fix with narrow scope, matching tests, and no post-approval changes.
